name: Amazon ECR "Login" Action for GitHub Actions
description: Logs in the local Docker client to one or more Amazon ECR Private registries or an Amazon ECR Public registry

http-proxy.description: Proxy to use for the AWS SDK agent.

mask-password.description: Mask the docker password to prevent it being printed to action logs if debug logging is enabled. NOTE: This will prevent the Docker password output from being s

registry-type.description: Which ECR registry type to log into. Options: [private, public]
